notes.title: Happy New Year! v1.35 Patch
notes.content:
I'd like to wish everyone a fantastic year ahead and also a big thank you to the continual feedback and bug reports to help make the game better!

Heres a list of fixes in this patch v1.35:

- Reaper Mode continues past Hydra boss
- Swallow Whole description changed
- Dwarven Ghost Event prompt text updated
- Santa Event does not appear outside of Seasons mode
- Feinting Strikes description changed
- Floating Stones fix
- Multistrike via Evolve works on the same turn to match other spells
- Treasure UI duplicate stacking fixed
- Escape Screen UI duplicate stacking fixed
- Mage intro cutscene subtitles fixed
- Talents can now scroll in the Hero stat UI
- Preparation Talent fixed

notes.title: Beginner Mode
notes.content:
Tailoring balance to a wide range of players has always been a challenge, but one we've strived to achieve.

Listening to the feedback of those less experienced with card games or roguelike deckbuilders has brought us valuable insight regarding the onboarding experience.

So we're excited to bring new players a fresh beginning and easier transition into the genre!

When selecting new game, player chooses between beginner and normal mode.

An Easier Experience of DungeonTop, Recommended for those inexperienced with card games.
- Heal after each battle
- More Card choices and selections after battles
- Less gold earned than Normal Mode

notes.title: v1.23 Helm and Karim updates
notes.content:
60 new cards for Helm
60 new cards for Karim
Mage unlock now 150 gold
First 5 Dungeon Ferocity difficulty modes

Holding SHIFT or ALT in battle shows your units remaining action & movements

Draft Mode:
Pick cards from all classes and allegiances for your starting deck and find powerful synergies between them on your run

3. Remove the old discard-for-mana mechanic.
